messages:
jordan: Heads up — SI partner Zenith wants to demo a LangChain + Redwood Gateway flow next Wed. Do we have a secure token exchange and audit wiring for a public-facing demo?

maria: We have a draft SSO/token exchange (OAuth PKCE + short-lived tokens) but marketplace requirements ask for persistent audit logs + retention policy. SI will need an NDA for access to keys.

alex: @maria I asked infra to confirm audit log retention windows. Also: do we run this on Dedicated or spin a Private instance for the demo?

sam: For customer data safety, recommend Private VPC. Zenith said they can host in their lab but want our gateway in front so they can show the orchestrator routing. If we must, Dedicated with strict ingress rules works too.

maria: Action list: 1) finalize PKCE flow and token exchange example, 2) configure audit log retention and export, 3) write a 1-page runbook for SI onboarding (keys, scopes, and preflight tests). I'll draft the runbook tonight.

jordan: Timeline check — Zenith asked for a dry run Tue 11am their timezone. Can we do internal dry run Tue 9am PT?

alex: Yes, internal dry run Tue 9am PT works. @sam can you reserve capacity and a test workspace?

sam: Reserved Tue 9-10am PT on a 4xA10G Dedicated pool; created a workspace with explicit KV cache hints and batching set to 64 tokens by default. Added notes about sequence-length mismatch causing latency spikes.

deploy-bot: notice: New doc created: /home/docs/partner-runbooks/zenith-runbook.md (created by maria)

maria: Runbook link (draft): https://redwood.example/s/zenith-runbook — please review section 'token-exchange' and 'preflight smoke tests' and comment inline.

jordan: Also filing comms items: co-announcement embargo window? propose 2-week hold after pilot sign-off. Marketing prefers a dev-showcase angle first, not a marketplace launch.

alex: Agreed. Keep it a "developer partner showcase" initially. We'll only publish HW benchmark numbers if Sigma (hardware partner) signs the benchmark NDA.

sam: FYI Sigma already asked to include perf numbers on the demo page. Do not publish any numbers until legal signs off.

maria: Noted and flagged in the runbook under 'public assets — blocked until NDA'.

jordan: I'll send Zenith the NDA link and invite them to the Tue dry run. Also cc legal and marketing on logistics.

alex: Thanks all — quick follow-ups: maria will post the final runbook by EOD, sam will confirm the workspace creds (secrets in Vault), jordan will handle NDA invite. :thumbsup:
